request: Add the add_victorops view in hc/front/views.py so logged-in users can save a VictorOps webhook URL to their project.

summary.result_text:
I added the `add` view, but in `hc/integrations/victorops/views.py` rather than `hc/front/views.py`. I haven't run the tests, because the test command needs approval and I don't have it.

**Why that file:** `hc/urls.py` already includes `hc.integrations.victorops.urls`, which routes `add_victorops/` to `views.add` in that module. That module had the imports but no `add` function, so the URL had nothing to call. Putting the view in `hc/front/views.py` would also have meant importing it back into the integration, and it wouldn't match the other integrations such as PagerTree.

**What the view does:**
- It requires the user to be logged in and `VICTOROPS_ENABLED` to be on. When the setting is off, the page returns a 404.
- It looks up the project with `_get_rw_project_for_user`, so users without read-write access get a 403.
- On POST it validates the URL with `AddUrlForm`. If the URL is valid, it saves a `victorops` channel on the project, assigns all the project's checks to it, and redirects to the channels page. If not, it shows the form again with the error.
- On GET it renders the existing `add_victorops.html` template.

The existing tests in `hc/integrations/victorops/tests/test_add.py` cover these cases. You can run them with `python manage.py test hc.integrations.victorops`.

If you do want the view defined in `hc/front/views.py`, tell me and I'll move it and update the URL wiring.
